user.title: Hemma
user.description: Adds Hemma to the sidebar, where you'll set up your dashboard.

create_entry.default: Hemma is ready. [Open Hemma](/hemma-studio) to create your dashboard, or find it in the sidebar any time.

theme_not_loaded.title: The Hemma theme isn't loading
theme_not_loaded.description: Hemma adds its theme to Home Assistant by itself, but it isn't in the theme list right now. Open Hemma from the sidebar and choose Run setup again from the ⋯ menu. If the theme is still missing, reload the Hemma integration under Settings > Devices & services.

theme_replaced.title: The Hemma theme was updated
theme_replaced.description:
Hemma now keeps its theme up to date for you, so it replaced the copy in `themes/hemma/`. That copy had changes, so it was saved to `{path}`.

To keep changes of your own, copy the theme to a new file and give the theme a new name.

theme_duplicate.title: There's a second copy of the Hemma theme
theme_duplicate.description:
Hemma keeps its theme in `themes/hemma/hemma.yaml` and updates it for you, but this file also defines a theme called Hemma: `{paths}`.

Delete that copy, or give its theme a new name, so Hemma can keep the theme up to date.

helpers_missing.title: Some Hemma helpers couldn't be created
helpers_missing.description: Hemma creates its helpers under Settings > Helpers by itself, but these couldn't be added: {helpers}. Open Hemma from the sidebar and press Repair, or choose Run setup again from the ⋯ menu. If an entity with one of these names already exists and isn't a helper, rename or remove it first.

light_smart_toggle.name: Smart light toggle
light_smart_toggle.description: Turns a light or light group off and remembers which lights were on, then turns exactly those back on.
